priorities.summary: An authentication bypass in Canonical's LXD and MicroCloud lets a remote attacker impersonate any trusted client without holding that client's private key, by attaching the client's public certificate to their own TLS chain. Fixed in LXD 6.10.1, 5.21.9, 5.0.11 and 4.0.15 and MicroCloud 3.4.1 and 2.1.5; no known exploitation as of October 30.

An integer overflow in the Onigmo regular-expression engine used by GitLab's CI/CD configuration processing lets an unauthenticated attacker execute arbitrary code on a self-managed GitLab server. CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 29 after probing of Alpine Linux's instance; patch to GitLab 19.2.8, 19.3.5 or 19.4.2 and confirm the underlying Ruby is fixed.

A use-after-free race in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP connection handling can be triggered remotely without authentication, and Anthropic demonstrated unauthenticated root command execution against a multipath TCP listener in a lab setting. Fixed kernels include 5.10.272, 5.15.223, 6.1.190, 6.6.159, 6.12.113, 6.18.56 and 7.2.10; apply the distribution kernel update and reboot.

model.name: GPT-6 Rosalind Research
model.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Rosalind Research on October 30, a frontier reasoning model for biology, drug discovery and translational medicine built on GPT-6 Astra's weights with no additional training. It is available only through a trusted-access programme for approved research organisations, with fewer refusals on dual-use biology queries but refusals retained for biological weaponisation.
